thread:
maya: Heads-up — Northstar emailed about limited A100 capacity in us-west-2 next Tue–Fri. They said preemptible pools might be impacted. Can infra owners confirm our slack and options? :eyes:

sam: How many GPUs would the affected runs need and which clusters?

maya: It's the customer load test for dedupe-service and a canary for new batching — approx 40 A100-equivalent GPUs over 6 hours (staggered).

jorge: Quick snapshot from our quota view, running the usual internal check.

sam: ran: 
```
rictl capacity get --region us-west-2 --class a100
# output
region: us-west-2\ntotal_quota: 150\nin_use: 138\nreserved_dedicated: 8\npending_requests: 4
```

sam: So usable spare is ~ (150 - 138 - 8) = 4 GPUs right now. Not enough for a 40 GPU job.

lina: We do have g5 fallback for lower throughput. Would that work for the canary? Perf delta is ~2.5x slower per token.

maya: Canary needs similar latency profile to prod — g5 probably won't cut it. We need either short-term vendor capacity or move some noncritical workloads off us-west-2.

jorge: I can look at rebalancing some batch jobs to us-east-1 and EU-central. WFH jobs are mostly night-run; could shift 20 GPUs easily if we change autoscale window.

sam: I'll open a short ticket for quota/redistribution and ping procurement about emergency capacity buy. tagging @procurement-bot for PO options.

procurement-bot: Created PR-8372 to request temporary capacity from Northstar. Estimated lead time 48–72h. Link: https://vendor-portal.example/PR-8372 :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks. If lead time is 72h that misses our Tue window. Any other vendor options?

sam: Quick vendor check: Polaris and Northstar both show low avail in us-west-2. We could reserve Azure NCas_T4_v3 in us-west but cost is 3x. Do we have budget for emergency?

lina: For the canary I'd take cost hit if it keeps SLA. Could we do a hybrid: 20 A100 from vendor (if they can deliver 24h) + 20 on-prem rebalance?

jorge: Rebalance plan: shift two batch queues (batch-analytics, nightly-embeddings) to us-east-1, adjust autoscaler to drain gracefully over 3h before Tue. I'll draft the changes and post CR.

sam: CR ping: @jorge can you drop the patch link? I'll review tomorrow morning.

jorge: Patch: https://git.example/repo/infra/+/change/4928 — changes autoscale windows and adds region tag to batch jobs.

maya: Perfect. Also want a fallback playbook if vendor fails: 1) abort nonessential tests, 2) scale canary to partial subset (10 GPUs) 3) run extended sampling to compare quality. I'll put that in the runbook.

capacity-bot: alert: cluster inference-prod capacity at 92% in us-west-2; predicted saturation in 36h if trend continues.

sam: Action items: Sam -> follow up with Northstar (ETA confirm), Jorge -> prepare rebalance patch & test, Lina -> confirm hybrid cost ok with product, Procurement-bot -> expedite PR-8372.

maya: Thanks team. If Northstar confirms same-day availability post-PR we can keep original schedule; otherwise we'll move to partial canary + rebalance. Please update thread with vendor ETA. :thumbsup:
